title: hoshidicts grc test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Ancient Greek dictionary for languages/grc/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack (GPL-3.0-or-later). Its nouns, adjectives and verbs carry the part-of-speech tags n, adj and v, as in wty-grc-en; the article, pronouns, numerals, particles and adverbs have none, as there, so τούτοισι reaches the untagged τοῦτος only with lookup.untaggedTerms pass. δύνω is a form-of row for δύω, as in wty-grc-en. Each pair of words is one that a rule could put in the wrong order.
